items.title: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: How Royal Mail will use AI to calculate supplier emissions
items.summary: The sustainability team at Royal Mail, Britain’s primary postal service, is testing a tool that uses artificial intelligence to estimate the potential carbon emissions that might be generated by new vendor contracts.

items.title: THIS WEEK: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: This week, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: Sustainability Uncovered episode 49: Bio-based materials and building with nature
items.summary: The latest episode of edie’s long-standing Sustainability Uncovered podcast is now live.

items.title: Pharmaceutical giants collaborate on supply chain clean heat initiative
items.summary: Pharmaceutical companies Sanofi, UCB and Opella have joined AstraZeneca as founding members of the Clean Heat Program to help organisations across the value chain switch to low-carbon heating alternatives.

items.title: Hitachi’s data storage subsidiary has 2040 net-zero target validated by SBTi
items.summary: Hitachi’s data storage and AI subsidiary has had near- and long-term targets to reduce emissions and reach net-zero by 2040 validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).

items.title: Masterclass: UK SRS: How your business can prepare now
items.summary: Event Date: 10/11/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST Join the Edie webinar Masterclass on 10 November 2026 to learn how your business can prepare for UK SRS.

items.title: Implementation of global agreements needs deeper integration – the UNCCD COP17 provides a pathway
items.summary: At a time when our global order appears increasingly fragile, the recent UN summit in Mongolia addressing land health and drought made clear that multilateral cooperation is more necessary than ever, says WWF's global food and agriculture leader, João Campari.

items.title: COP31 Action Tracker: Crossing 1.5C, co-host controversy and Burnham’s first summit
items.summary: With COP31 in Türkiye less than two months away, this regular members-only series from edie will provide a temperature check on global climate action, including news from businesses, governments and other key organisations ahead of the summit.

items.title: edie launches Countdown to COP31 ahead of UN climate summit in Türkiye
items.summary: With less than two months until COP31 begins in Antalya, edie is hosting a series of exclusive digital content and events to set the scene and keep readers informed of key climate diplomacy news.
